description: Laboratory experiments for this course are based upon the corresponding theory course RAPC-302 (Microprocessors & Microcontrollers). An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Write and execute assembly language programs for 8085 microprocessor and 8051 microcontroller.
Interface peripheral devices such as ADC/DAC, timers, and I/O ports with microprocessors and microcontrollers.
Develop simple embedded system applications using 8051 microcontroller.
Test, debug, and troubleshoot microprocessor and microcontroller-based circuits and systems.
